notes: The guard (line 220: 'if isServerRunning, configManager.config.activeServerId == cfgServer.id') lives in the orchestration layer, before WorldSlotManager.activateSlot is ever called -- WorldSlotManager itself has no concept of 'running' and enforces nothing (see the file header comment at WorldSlotManager.swift:19-20: 'The server MUST be stopped before any slot operation that touches world data. WorldSlotManager enforces nothing here -- the caller (AppViewModel) is responsible.'). The identical shape of guard (isServerRunning && activeServerId == this server) also gates renameWorld (AppViewModel+WorldManagement.swift:160-164) and replaceWorld (line 55-58) -- see replace-world-refuses-while-server-running for that call site's version. Phase 6's application service must own this check itself, since the pure world-slot repository (P6.10) is deliberately as ignorant of server-running-state as WorldSlotManager is.
